title_as_printed: CSF peptides from VGF and other markers enhance prediction of MCI to AD progression using the ATN framework
blind_code_notes: Year: issue Neurobiology of Aging 121 (2023); online 1 Oct 2022.

registry_codes.Sample_N_Approx: EMCI 187 (168 stable/19 converters) + LMCI 119 (63 stable/56 converters); full sample for state classification

Task_Type.reason: Core result is prediction of 36-month MCI-to-AD conversion (EMCI/LMCI converters vs stable) with sensitivity, specificity, balanced accuracy and ROC AUC.
Task_Type.quote: a derivative from VGF, when combined with AT markers, most strongly enhanced prediction of MCI to AD conversion

Category.reason: CSF amyloid/tau and targeted-proteomics CSF peptides (VGF, NPTX2, SPP1, CHI3L1, YWHAZ) plus CSF GAP-43; APOE and demographics as covariates.

Validation_Type.reason: Signatures are tuned by 10 x 10-fold stratified CV on CUI vs AD and then evaluated on a separate, held-out test set of EMCI and LMCI subjects not used in training; Table 3 labels these columns 'Test Set'. That is k-fold plus a held-out test partition (V3), not CV-only (V2). Not V4: the test subjects (and the second VGF confirmation cohort) are also from ADNI.
Validation_Type.quote: Performance of the signatures derived from these algorithms for accurately classifying CUI versus AD subjects was estimated via 10 iterations of 10-fold stratified cross-validation ... These signatures were then applied to an independent group of EMCI and LMCI subjects at baseline to predict their future progression to AD within 36-months.

Sample_N_Approx.reason: The paper analyses 719 subjects in total; the registry string totals 306 (EMCI 187 + LMCI 119), which is the 36-month conversion test set in Table 2, and leaves the full sample unquantified. The registry uses one of the paper's Ns (test set rather than total).
Sample_N_Approx.quote: Data from 719 subjects across NL, SMC, EMCI, LMCI, and AD were included in this study

Publication_Year.reason: Neurobiology of Aging 121 (2023) 15-27; available online 1 October 2022.

ADNI_Dependent.quote: Subjects in this study were drawn from ADNI-GO and ADNI-2

notes: The validation miscode matters for the review's validation-tier statistics, since this is a classification study (V2 undercounts held-out testing). The Sample_N string begins with '187' (the EMCI subset); a parser taking the first integer would record 187, which is neither the total (719) nor the test set (306). Recommend Sample_N_Approx = 719 (test set 306).
